summary: Web research on DAG/workflow + PM-graph space vs our agent task-graph orchestrator. VERDICT: ~70% re-skin of a 15-yr-solved DAG pattern; genuine novelty is narrow but real — two-tier context handoff between autonomous agents + hook-enforced claim/dispatch. BIGGEST THREAT: Anthropic shipped native DAG subagent orchestration ("Tasks"/dynamic workflows) into Claude Code itself May 2026, commoditizing the core. Differentiation must be the persistent cross-session multi-workspace graph + context-edge handoff layer, not the DAG.
